title: $100 Off MM1500 Juicer – Watch It Make Hummus, Almond Milk, Guacamole & Brain Shot
text: [Music] all right I'm making hummus these are garbanzo beans I am gonna put sesame seeds and the other decision is am I gonna put herbs in here yes I am is that insane it's insane a pinch of salt down in there too I'm even gonna drop some lemon juice down in there look at that gorgeous little display making nut milk too I soak these almonds so what I love about this machine is because it has an ability to pulverize to such a degree it's going to extract nutrients out of those almonds that you wouldn't get from the traditional store-bought almond milk this is the biggest sale on this machine ever so far it's a hundred dollars off you guys know I work with the mega and everything the price is unbelievable for what it can do for you and what it has to offer okay your mind is going to be blown you taste pureness you taste cleanness next on the list we're making the guacamole a little bit of lime down in there and I'm gonna put a little bit of salt down there too and there we are right there probably one of my favorite things to do is make the parsley shot which is the nerve gut acid stabilizer I'm running parsley through here parsley is not easy to juice and this is totally crushing it you need a powerful juicer that doesn't destroy the nutrients but still juices The Parsley when you're sick you need a main line of direct nutrients and when you're using something like the mm-1500 you're getting that many nutrients out of it you're getting a main line directly into your system this is practically dust good luck with any other juicer ever seeing that we're making a lot of things but this is an important one right here right there boom check it out wait a minute here you know what I forgot ah I forgot the natural flavors and the MSG and the carrageenan I forgot to put that in here oh bummer I forgot to put all the poison into the almond milk what was I thinking
